title: BLTTA Tortas
ldKeywords: BLT sandwich, BLT subs, Mexican sub
ldIngredientsRaw: 4 slices Applegate Natural Oven Roasted Turkey Breast
4 slices  cooked Applegate Organics Sunday Bacon Brand
ldInstructionsRaw: In a small bowl, combine the avocado and mayonnaise and mix well. Season with salt.
To assemble tortas, spread avocado mayonnaise on torta. Add bacon, lettuce, tomato, and turkey.
htmlIngredientLines: ▢ 1 avocado, peeled, pitted and coarsely mashed
▢ 4 slices Applegate Natural Oven Roasted Turkey Breast
▢ 4 slices  cooked Applegate Organics Sunday Bacon Brand
